thread:
emily: Quick sync — need to lock DP eligibility and feedback slot cadence for the next private preview cohort. Proposed: 8 partners, 3 feedback sessions each, 45m per session. Thoughts?

sam: +1 on cohort size. Need to gate on NDA + data access level (can they share prompts/logs). also suggest min usage signal (e.g., >2k tokens/day) so we get real infra telemetry. :thinking_face:

maya: Agree on data access. Also recommend we split partners by primary workload (chat vs embeddings) so evaluation metrics are comparable.

noah: Scheduling note — Ops asked for fixed weekly slots to streamline recording and notes. Could do Wed 10:00–10:45 PT and Thu 14:00–14:45 PT, rotate partners.

emily: Sam — do we have legal template for a light DP NDA + data sharing consent? If not, can we do a one-pager?

sam: We have a DP-friendly one-pager, will share. Also confirm whether we need EULA addendum for telemetry ingestion.

lara: Success criteria proposal: at least 75% of partners attend ≥2 sessions, 80% of flagged regressions reproduced internally, and one actionable product change per partner. If we hit that, we consider beta-ready. :white_check_mark:

maya: +1 to Lara. Also add quality guardrail: automated eval pass-rate not drop >5% vs baseline on partner prompts.

emily: For intake, I sketched a tiny form — can we capture these fields?
```
- Company name
- Primary workload (chat/embeddings/other)
- Monthly token volume estimate
- Data sensitivity level (none/low/med/high)
- Want to share logs? (yes/no)
- Key contact + timezone
- Top 3 success measures for you
```

noah: That form looks good. Also add a freeform "blocking constraints" field (infra, legal, SSO).

sam: I'll attach the NDA and telemetry consent + checklist for legal.

calendar-bot: Created event "DP feedback slot — cohort A" Wed 10:00–10:45 PT (recurring weekly) — https://calendar.example/evt/12345 — RSVP to hold a slot.

emily: Ops question — do we reserve buffer slots for follow-ups or demos? propose 2 buffer slots per month.

lara: Buffer slots = yes. And schedule one monthly synthesis meeting (internal) to roll up partner signals. 30m should do it.

maya: One more ask: log collection guide (minimal set) so partners know how to redact sensitive bits before sharing. I'll draft and post in #docs.

emily: Great — action items: Sam share NDA + consent by EOD Thurs; Maya draft log guide by next Tue; Noah confirm slot rotation cadence; Ops reserve 2 buffer slots. I'll update DF intake form and publish a short invite email template. :rocket:

noah: Confirmed slot rotation and buffer reservation.

sam: NDA + consent uploaded to drive: https://drive.example/dp-nda-2026

emily: Perfect — thanks team. We'll run a dry-run with an internal partner next week and iterate.
